question: According to NACO/WHO guidelines, all HIV-positive mothers in India should avoid breastfeeding entirely and use exclusive formula feeding to eliminate any risk of postnatal HIV transmission.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct reasoning. WHO/NACO do not advise universal formula feeding. Exclusive breastfeeding under ART cover is recommended for the first 6 months when formula is not AFASS. Advising all HIV-positive mothers to stop breastfeeding is a well-documented clinical error.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: This is actually false. WHO/NACO guidelines support exclusive breastfeeding for 6 months with continued ART (which reduces MTCT risk to <2%), provided formula feeding is not AFASS (acceptable, feasible, affordable, sustainable, safe). Blanket advice to avoid breastfeeding is incorrect in resource-limited settings.
